pages.title: Femtoscale Inductor
pages.text: A superconducting coil wound around nothing, smaller than a proton. Its magnetic field stores energy in empty space, and its current never stops. It is too small to see and occasionally tugs at steel nearby.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Femto Fabricator, I wound a Superconducting Coil around a sliver of neutronium with Superconducting Solder, then removed the core. The coil held its shape around nothing.
